desc: Implement a BIT class with size, internal array tree, update(i, val) (max assignment), query(i) (prefix max).
Read N, Q, the array A (1-indexed), and the Q queries.
Build list of positions sorted by A[i] ascending.
Sort queries by X ascending, storing original index.
Initialize two Fenwick trees: bitPos size N (stores dp at index i), bitVal size M (stores max dp per compressed value).
Sweep pointer over sorted positions; for each query in sorted order:
While next position has A[pos] ≤ X, activate it: compute dp = 1 + bitVal.query(v-1), update bitVal at v with dp, update bitPos at i with dp.
Answer = bitPos.query(R); store in answers array at original index.
After processing all queries, output answers in original order, one per line.
